purpose_context: Mission #5 (dashboard-governance-config) shipped the charter remove action for orphaned entries but left a UX gap: entries whose artefact no longer exists in the pack render as bare links with no visual signal. This mission adds a 'not found' indicator badge to orphaned entries and resolves a pre-existing failing Vitest test in reviews.routes.test.ts (unrelated to mission #5 changes) that has been carrying forward since before the overhaul branch.
purpose_tldr: Display a 'not found' badge on orphaned charter entries and fix the pre-existing reviews-routes test failure
